name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Repair.gadget_decode_unique
title: Noisy gadget encodings of one value are uniquely decodable modulo 2^k
statement: Let k be a natural number and d an integer. If for every b < k there is an integer r with |r| < 2^(k-1) and 2^b d congruent to r modulo 2^k, then d is divisible by 2^k. Applied to d = x - x', it says that the encodings y_b = 2^b x + e_b mod 2^k (b < k, |e_b| < 2^(k-2)) determine x modulo 2^k. Used in the note pq-we-repairs-collision-rank-gap to break the gadget-decomposition repair of the rank-gap-as-LWE-dimension-gap witness-encryption candidate.
